effect.name: Colorful Grayout Foilage (Switch)
effect.description: Similar effect to CPU Foilage (Switch), but different material.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Colorful Grayout Foilage Shader | 2026.08.27 */
parameter.description: Similar effect to CPU Foilage (Switch), but different material.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Position X
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the rainbow in the X axis.

parameter.name: Position Y
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the rainbow in the Y axis.
